root_motivation: **Who.** Any agent sharing an egress address and client build with another agent: every truth-tier persona on orch, two Claude Code users behind one office NAT, two tabs of one web client.
user_persona: An agent that calls host.sync.create with a source ref and gets a scheduled mirror in one call; Operator Joe who reads docs/tools.md and llms.txt and knows both were rendered from the SourceKind enum.

acceptance_criteria.description: Given the in-process test host and two initialized sessions from one source IP and one User-Agent, When session A signs up with handoff and redeems, and session B then calls `host.table.create` without `tenant_key` inside the 10-minute window, Then B's call succeeds with `implicit: true` and the tenants table holds two distinct tenants.

Given session A of AC 1, When A calls `host.table.create` again without `tenant_key` inside the window, Then the call succeeds as A's tenant through the session binding (the call row's auth method is `session`), no second tenant is created, and no `tenant_key_missing` error is produced (the gate is never reached by the redeeming session).

Given two requests from the same IP and User-Agent inside the window, one with no `Mcp-Session-Id` and one with a forged id this process never minted, When each calls `host.table.create` without `tenant_key`, Then each error is `-32602` `tenant_key_missing`, `data.reason` `peer_recent`, `data.session_presented` `false`, no `data.tenant`, and the hint contains `initialize` and `/t/` but neither A's namespace nor `pass the key`.

Given every `Reason` variant, When each error's `message` and `data.hint` are rendered, Then the PeerRecent and ConnectionBound texts contain neither `pass the key` nor `tenant_key argument`, the Anonymous text is byte-identical to v0.118.8, and `errors.json` (the `error_registry` generator) lists the three hints under `tenant_key_missing.reasons`.

Given the window elapsed (mock clock past 600 s), When a sessionless request from the same peer calls `host.table.create` without `tenant_key`, Then implicit signup proceeds as in v0.118.8 (the TTL is unchanged).

Given the refusals of AC 3 and the yield of AC 1, When the journal is read, Then the refusal lines carry `session_presented=false` and the yield line carries `peer_recent_yielded=true`, each with the tool name, and no line carries a key or another tenant's namespace.
Given the test host, When `/contract.json` is fetched anonymously, Then `onboarding.implicit_signup.scope` is `"session"` and `onboarding.peer_recent.window_secs` is `600`.

Given prod after this PRD's deploy, When the AC 8 command in § Live evidence commands runs from the build host, Then it prints `ipsess_ac08 A=offboarded B=offboarded rc=0` and exits 0 (Live; evidence: AC 8 command in § Live evidence commands, last two lines of its output)
acceptance_criteria.test: deferred: Live (prod; evidence: AC 8 command in § Live evidence commands, last two lines of its output)

scope: src/sync/mod.rs: the SourceKind registry, host.sync.create/list/get/delete/run_now, and the trigger tick's sync pass writing a not_implemented sync_runs receipt.
migrations/0130_syncs.sql: syncs and sync_runs tables; Plan.syncs_max (free 5, pro 50) and the quota_syncs_max, connection_missing and schedule_too_frequent error codes.
www/llms.txt gains a generated Data sync section and docs/tools.md the source.kind enum, both rendered from SourceKind.
non_goals: Fetching rows (the pull PRD); push or conflict handling (the two-way PRD); type inference beyond text columns; any new OAuth flow.

additional.main_database_tables: syncs and sync_runs live in the main database (migration 0130), not a per-tenant file, so the tick's sync pass is one indexed query across tenants.

five_whys_trace.q: Why can an agent not keep a host table equal to a sheet?
five_whys_trace.a: No verb registers an external source; the agent would own a puller, a token and a diff loop.
host.table.append cannot update a row and host.trigger.set only calls a published tool.
One SourceKind enum generates the schema, docs and dispatch, so the five kinds cannot drift.

ambiguities_resolved.question: What is source.secret?
ambiguities_resolved.resolution: The NAME of a host.secret (stored as secret_name), never a value, so no secret-named field exists on a Debug struct.

ambiguities_resolved.question: Do push and two_way modes run?
ambiguities_resolved.resolution: They are accepted at create with status pending_mode (the PRD default) and the tick skips them.
